pr.body:
## Summary
- add offline canonical datastore schema and safe pack importer
- add deterministic active-source resolver and coldstart reports
- produce full dry-run reconciliation artifacts for the June 22 pack

## Validation
- python -m pytest -q tests/tools/test_task_orchestrator_reconcile_import.py
- python -m compileall -q tools/task_orchestrator_reconcile tests/tools
- git diff --check

steps.task: Implement safe pack importer that writes only to caller-supplied offline SQLite output.
validation: Importer preserves provenance and rejects unredacted note bodies.
